products.name: HOW TO POWER BUGLE ELK DVD
products.source_description_html: I have bee around a lot of different elk bugling in my 40 years of filming. The E.L.K., Inc. “Power Bugle”, without a doubt, is the most powerful, realistic elk bugle ever developed. You owe it to yourself to learn “Power Bugling”. It will become a household phrase like “Cow Talk” is in the elk hunting world. When you see the video you will understand why I am so high on “Power Bugling” elk. One of the most exciting sequences is when an old bull leaves his cows and travels 600 yards to come to the “Power Bugle”, throwing dirt clods 20 yards into the air—he came to fight. You will see several sic point bulls challenge the “Power Bugle” as close as 20 feet. This video is not only on bugling, but a source of information on why, when, where and how to become a successful elk bugler. 60 minutes.

products.name: HUNTING COYOTES DVD
products.source_description_html: No matter how many times a person hunts coyotes, the circumstances are different. The changing weather conditions, time of day, time of year, proper stands, terrain, calling techniques, they all add up to a challenging sport. The coyote challenge is very addictive. Coyote populations continue to explode across the United States and Canada causing havoc with birds, small game, big game, pets, livestock, fruit and vegetable farms – the list goes on and on. The only realistic option for controlling excessive coyote populations is by hunting. Whether a person uses dogs, calls or is just out there hunting, essential tips can be extracted by viewing the dedicated coyote hunters in “Howling Coyotes”. Filmed in Wyoming and Montana. 60 minutes.

products.name: COYOTE ACTION DVD
products.source_description_html: Predator control is a never ending battle for ranchers, big game managers, bird farms, bird populations and urban areas. If coyote numbers are not kept under control they can cause havoc with everything they pursue. The sportsmen can be a key element in keeping coyote populations in check. Most states allow year-round hunting of coyotes. This gives the hunter an opportunity to test his skills as well as controlling the ever expanding coyote populations. “Coyote Action” is about calling coyotes during the spring, summer and fall. The new “Yote Howler”™ and “Mini-Siren” became a very effective combination. In some areas we hunted with our coyote dogs and they became an integral part of the call-ins. Howling and using a squeaker is a deadly system for callers as you will see in “Coyote Action”. Filmed in Montana and Wyoming. 60 minutes.

products.name: HOW TO TALK TO THE DEER DVD
products.source_description_html: It’s all on film. Gordon Eastman and Don Laubach have learned to “Talk to the Deer”. Three years in the making, they have now perfected the right call sounds to bring the bucks in and get the deer to talk back. This is the most exciting hunting tool since they produced the original “Cow Talk” elk call that revolutionized elk hunting. Learn how to use the “Deer Stopper” to stop bucks in full flight, hold the deer for that perfect, shot, call deer out of hiding and find and observe all the deer in the area. Get the deer to talk back to your calls. Gordon Eastman is not satisfied to tell you how it works. He shows you on film how it works, why it works and when it works, with the real deer sounds for you to practice with. It will also work on Whitetail deer, although this film was produced for the Mule Deer hunter. “How to Talk to the Deer” is a video every sportsman will want to view over and over again. 60 minutes.

products.name: Royal Bugle Pro Edition
products.source_description_html:
The Royal Bugle Pro Edition is the same Rover Bugle that you love, with all the latest and greatest accessories we have to offer.

THE ROYAL BUGLE IS VERY UNIQUE YET EXTREMELY EASY TO USE. IT WILL PRODUCE SQUEALS, GRUNTS, SCREAMS, CHUCKLES, GROWLS AND FULL RUT BUGLES. VARYING AIR PRESSURE CREATES THE SOUNDS.

Adjustments: The mouth piece will slide in and out allowing you to adjust the opening between the housing and the band to fit your lip size. Once you find the correct opening size, check the adjustments marks or place friction cloth behind to ease resetting in the future. The call is set for approximately the correct opening.

Instructions:

  1. Put the call in your mouth until your lips touch the back portion of the housing.
  2. Varying air pressure with your tongue will keep the band from sticking to your lips.
  3. Slightly slant the housing down. Your upper lip will block the upper opening.
  4. BUGLES - Begin with your lower lip relaxed. This will give you a low grunting beginning. As you blow, tighten up your lower lip, maintaining air pressure. The more you tighten your lower lip, the higher the pitch will be. To end the bugle, quickly relax your lips, drop your bottom jaw and force what air you have left in your lungs out.
  5. SQUEALS & CHUCKLES - Begin with your lip relaxed. Force a short burst of air out and quickly relax your lips and drop your bottom jaw. A series of chuckles can also be accomplished using this method.
  6. SQUEALS - Begin with your lips tight. As you blow, maintain air pressure and air pressure. To end your squeal, quickly relax your lips, drop your bottom jaw and force what air you have left in your lungs out.
  7. SCREAMS - With the call in your mouth. With your lips relaxed, blow the air over both sides of the band. Vibrate the entire sides of the band to vibrate and make a raspy, screaming sound. To end your scream, quickly force what air you have left in your lungs out while dropping your bottom jaw.
  8. GROWLS - Start with your lips relaxed. As you blow, use your voice with a deep, low gutteral hum. Growls can be used at the beginning and ending of bugles, squeals and screams.

Features:

  • Quickly extends from 10" to 24" providing a variety of realistic sounds.
  • Elastic lanyard allows you to use the call freely while keeping it snug against your body while on stand (models with reeds from one call to another with adjustable tube)
  • Produce bugles and cow sounds

products.description:
The Royal Bugle Pro Edition is the same Rover Bugle that you love, with all the latest and greatest accessories we have to offer.

THE ROYAL BUGLE IS VERY UNIQUE YET EXTREMELY EASY TO USE. IT WILL PRODUCE SQUEALS, GRUNTS, SCREAMS, CHUCKLES, GROWLS AND FULL RUT BUGLES. VARYING AIR PRESSURE CREATES THE SOUNDS.

Adjustments: The mouth piece will slide in and out allowing you to adjust the opening between the housing and the band to fit your lip size. Once you find the correct opening size, check the adjustments marks or place friction cloth behind to ease resetting in the future. The call is set for approximately the correct opening.

Instructions:

 Put the call in your mouth until your lips touch the back portion of the housing.

 Varying air pressure with your tongue will keep the band from sticking to your lips.

 Slightly slant the housing down. Your upper lip will block the upper opening.

 BUGLES - Begin with your lower lip relaxed. This will give you a low grunting beginning. As you blow, tighten up your lower lip, maintaining air pressure. The more you tighten your lower lip, the higher the pitch will be. To end the bugle, quickly relax your lips, drop your bottom jaw and force what air you have left in your lungs out.

 SQUEALS & CHUCKLES - Begin with your lip relaxed. Force a short burst of air out and quickly relax your lips and drop your bottom jaw. A series of chuckles can also be accomplished using this method.

 SQUEALS - Begin with your lips tight. As you blow, maintain air pressure and air pressure. To end your squeal, quickly relax your lips, drop your bottom jaw and force what air you have left in your lungs out.

 SCREAMS - With the call in your mouth. With your lips relaxed, blow the air over both sides of the band. Vibrate the entire sides of the band to vibrate and make a raspy, screaming sound. To end your scream, quickly force what air you have left in your lungs out while dropping your bottom jaw.

 GROWLS - Start with your lips relaxed. As you blow, use your voice with a deep, low gutteral hum. Growls can be used at the beginning and ending of bugles, squeals and screams.

 Quickly extends from 10" to 24" providing a variety of realistic sounds.

products.name: COYOTE HUNTER BOOK
products.source_description_html: Picture the perfect predator. That predator is the coyote. From the Atlantic to pacific and Canada to Mexico, coyotes have spread and prospered inhabiting every type of ecological niche. But even perfect predators need to be managed. “The Coyote Hunter” offers a complete look at tactics, equipment and techniques for hunting coyotes. The book includes sections on everything from basic biology and lifestyles, to clothing and rifles, to calling strategies and using coyote dogs. For the beginner and advanced hunter alike, “The Coyote Hunter” offers a complete look at hunting one of North America’s most challenging predators.
